name: pulse-verity
description: Signed, verifiable crypto index prices for 5,000+ assets. Read-only tools over the Pulse Verity Index API, plus local signature verification.
long_description: Every price the Pulse Verity Index publishes is signed with ECDSA P-256 and can be verified against a public key. This extension gives Claude five read-only tools: the current signed price for one symbol, a batch of up to 100 symbols, the asset catalogue with coverage and cadence, the recorded print nearest a timestamp, and an offline verifier for any signed print. A free developer key from https://thepulse.markets/developers is required.

pulse_api_key.title: Pulse API key
pulse_api_key.description: Your developer key, starting with pidx_. Free at https://thepulse.markets/developers (60 requests a minute, no card).
